title: Pool, yum cha, Ozone at sunset, then fly
call: Fine, 25 to 30°, east to north-east force 3 to 4: the calmest and clearest day. The best pool morning and a clear sunset at Ozone. If Thursday switched to the backup, this is the Ngong Ping day: 08:45 train, 10:00 cable car, back at the hotel about 14:15.
plan: Sheraton pool, or Lantau in the backup
